```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
rm(list=ls())
par(mar = c(2, 2, 2, 2))


library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtext)         
library(ggnewscale)     
library(ggh4x)         
library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggnewscale)
library(forcats)

library(kableExtra)
library(conflicted)

conflicts_prefer(
  # dplyr verbs
  dplyr::summarise, dplyr::summarize, dplyr::filter, dplyr::select,
  dplyr::mutate, dplyr::arrange, dplyr::rename, dplyr::count,
  dplyr::desc, dplyr::slice, dplyr::first, dplyr::last, dplyr::lag,
  # base functions that Bioconductor packages mask
  base::as.factor, base::setdiff, base::intersect, base::union,
  base::unique, base::rbind, base::cbind,
  .quiet = TRUE
)
```

```{r loading-data-and-setup}
#not rarefied dataset "ps2"
load("R_output//ps_objects//GrandRiverMB_phyloseq_filt_unnorm.RData")

#rarefied dataset "ps_rare"
load("R_output//ps_objects//GrandRiverMB_phyloseq_filt_rar.RData")

#css-normalized dataset "ps_css"
load("R_output//ps_objects//GrandRiverMB_phyloseq_filt_css.RData")

#TSS-normalized dataset "ps_prop"
load("R_output//ps_objects//GrandRiverMB_phyloseq_filt_propnorm.RData")

#select dataset
dataset <- "_final"
ps <- get(paste0("ps", dataset))

# Create output directory
output_dir <- paste0("R_output//taxabarplot") 
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

#list of taxa
desired_taxa_order <- c("Chironomidae", "Heptageniidae", "Hydropsychidae", "Araneid", "Tetragnatha")

#select color brewer palette
#display.brewer.all()
pal<-"Paired"
```

## Phylum level

```{r select-phylum-number-taxa}
taxrank <- "Phylum"   # "or "Phylum", "Family", etc.
top_n <- 9           # Number of top taxa to display

```

### Plots by city

```{r plots-by-sample-type-phy, results='asis', fig.height=6, fig.width=12}
#Aggregate and transform to relative abundance ####
ps_tax <- tax_glom(ps, taxrank = taxrank)
ps_relabund <- transform_sample_counts(ps_tax, function(x) x / sum(x))
df <- psmelt(ps_relabund)

# Clean variables 
df[[taxrank]] <- as.character(df[[taxrank]])
df[[taxrank]][is.na(df[[taxrank]])] <- "Unclassified"

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    location = as.factor(Location),
    site = as.factor(Site_ID),
    sample_type = as.factor(Sample_Type),
    taxa = factor(Taxa, levels = desired_taxa_order),
    lifestage = as.factor(Lifestage),
    city = as.factor(Site)
  )

df$location <- factor(df$location, levels = c("UP", "DWN"))



#Calculate mean across replicates
group_means <- df %>%
  group_by(site, location, city, taxa, lifestage, .data[[taxrank]]) %>%
  summarise(mean_abundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Identify top N taxa by total abundance 
top_taxa <- group_means %>%
  group_by(.data[[taxrank]]) %>%
  summarise(total_mean_abundance = sum(mean_abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_max(order_by = total_mean_abundance, n = top_n) %>%
  pull(.data[[taxrank]])

# Recode low-abundance taxa as 'Other' 
group_means[[taxrank]] <- fct_other(group_means[[taxrank]], keep = top_taxa, other_level = "Other")

#  Aggregate again to sum 'Other' values  
plot_data <- group_means %>%
  group_by(site, location, city, taxa, lifestage, .data[[taxrank]]) %>%
  summarise(mean_abundance = sum(mean_abundance), .groups = "drop")

# Ensure consistent taxa and location order
plot_data$taxa <- factor(plot_data$taxa, levels = c(desired_taxa_order, setdiff(unique(plot_data$taxa), desired_taxa_order)))

# Generate color palette
n_taxa <- length(unique(plot_data[[taxrank]]))

if (n_taxa <= 8) {
  fill_scale <- scale_fill_brewer(palette = pal, name = taxrank)
} else {
  fill_colors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, pal))(n_taxa)
  fill_scale <- scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors, name = taxrank)
}

# Loop through cities and create plots  
cities <- unique(plot_data$city)
plot_list <- list()

for (current_city in cities) {
  
  city_data <- plot_data %>% filter(city == current_city)
  
  p <- ggplot(city_data, aes(x = location, y = mean_abundance, fill = .data[[taxrank]])) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black") +
    facet_nested_wrap(~ taxa + lifestage, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
    fill_scale +
    labs(
    #  title = paste("City:", current_city),
      x = "Location",
      y = "Mean Relative Abundance"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
    )
  
  # adding header for knit
  cat("\n\n#### City: ", current_city, "\n\n")
  print(p)
  
  # save polot
  output_base <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(tolower(taxrank), "_top", top_n, "_plot_", current_city))
  ggsave(paste0(output_base, ".png"), plot = p, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  ggsave(paste0(output_base, ".pdf"), plot = p, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  
  plot_list[[as.character(current_city)]] <- p
}
```

```{r plots-all-together-phy, fig.height=8, fig.width=30}
# Combined plot faceted by city:
p_combined <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = location, y = mean_abundance, fill = .data[[taxrank]])) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black") +
  facet_nested_wrap(city ~ taxa + lifestage, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +  # city as rows, taxa+lifestage as columns
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  fill_scale +
  labs(
    title = paste("Mean Relative Abundance by City"),
    x = "Location",
    y = "Mean Relative Abundance"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )

print(p_combined)

# Save  combined plot
ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(tolower(taxrank),"_top",top_n, "_plot_combined.png")), 
       plot = p_combined, width = 30, height = 8, dpi = 300)
ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(tolower(taxrank),"_top",top_n, "_plot_combined.pdf")), 
       plot = p_combined, width = 30, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

## Summary Statistics: Top Phyla Across Dataset

```{r summary-top-taxa, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# collapse to desired taxrank and relative abundance
ps_tax <- tax_glom(ps, taxrank = taxrank)
ps_relabund <- transform_sample_counts(ps_tax, function(x) x / sum(x))
df <- psmelt(ps_relabund)

# clean taxrank NAs
df[[taxrank]] <- as.character(df[[taxrank]])
df[[taxrank]][is.na(df[[taxrank]])] <- "Unclassified"

#### Step 3: Calculate mean relative abundance across the entire dataset ####
top_taxa_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(.data[[taxrank]]) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_abundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_abundance = median(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_abundance = sd(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_abundance = max(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_abundance = min(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_samples_present = sum(Abundance > 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_abundance)) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n)

# Save as CSV 
write.csv(top_taxa_summary, file = file.path(output_dir, paste0("Top_", taxrank, "_Summary.csv")), row.names = FALSE)

# Display table in knitted document
top_taxa_summary %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(., 3))) %>%
  kable(caption = paste0("Top ", top_n, " Most Abundant ", taxrank, " Across Entire Dataset"),
        align = "lrrrrrr") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"))

#extra summary by Sample_Type
top_taxa_by_sampletype <- df %>%
  filter(.data[[taxrank]] %in% top_taxa_summary[[taxrank]]) %>%
  group_by(Sample_Type, .data[[taxrank]]) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_abundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_abundance = median(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_abundance = sd(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_samples_present = sum(Abundance > 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Sample_Type, desc(mean_abundance))

write.csv(top_taxa_by_sampletype, file = file.path(output_dir, paste0("Top_", taxrank, "_By_SampleType.csv")), row.names = FALSE)

#e xtra summary by Lifestage
top_taxa_by_lifestage <- df %>%
  filter(.data[[taxrank]] %in% top_taxa_summary[[taxrank]]) %>%
  group_by(Lifestage, .data[[taxrank]]) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_abundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_abundance = median(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_abundance = sd(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_samples_present = sum(Abundance > 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Lifestage, desc(mean_abundance))

write.csv(top_taxa_by_lifestage, file = file.path(output_dir, paste0("Top_", taxrank, "_By_Lifestage.csv")), row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r summary-plot-phyla}
# Filter top taxa from previously calculated top_taxa_summary
top_taxa_names <- top_taxa_summary[[taxrank]]  # from summary table chunk

# Filter dataframe for only those top taxa
plot_df <- df %>% filter(.data[[taxrank]] %in% top_taxa_names)

# Generate color palette based on number of taxa
n_taxa <- length(top_taxa_names)
if (n_taxa <= 8) {
  fill_scale <- scale_fill_brewer(palette = pal, name = taxrank)
} else {
  fill_colors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, pal))(n_taxa)
  fill_scale <- scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors, name = taxrank)
}

# boxplot of relative abundance across entire dataset
p_summary <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = .data[[taxrank]], y = Abundance, fill = .data[[taxrank]])) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  fill_scale +
  labs(
    title = paste("Top", top_n, taxrank, "Relative Abundance Across Entire Dataset"),
    x = taxrank,
    y = "Relative Abundance"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_summary)

ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0("Summary_Top", top_n, "_", taxrank, "_Barplot.png")),
       plot = p_summary, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0("Summary_Top", top_n, "_", taxrank, "_Barplot.pdf")),
       plot = p_summary, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)


# plot2 by sample type
p_sampletype <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = .data[[taxrank]], y = Abundance, fill = .data[[taxrank]])) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  fill_scale +
  facet_wrap(~ Sample_Type) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Top", top_n, taxrank, "Relative Abundance by Sample Type"),
    x = taxrank,
    y = "Relative Abundance"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_sampletype)

ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0("Summary_Top", top_n, "_", taxrank, "_Barplot_bySampleType.png")),
       plot = p_sampletype, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)


ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0("Summary_Top", top_n, "_", taxrank, "_Barplot_bySampleType.pdf")),
       plot = p_sampletype, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)


# plot 3 by lifestage
p_lifestage <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = .data[[taxrank]], y = Abundance, fill = .data[[taxrank]])) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  fill_scale +
  facet_wrap(~ Lifestage) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Top", top_n, taxrank, "Relative Abundance by Lifestage"),
    x = taxrank,
    y = "Relative Abundance"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_lifestage)

ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0("Summary_Top", top_n, "_", taxrank, "_Barplot_byLifestage.png")),
       plot = p_lifestage, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 600)

ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0("Summary_Top", top_n, "_", taxrank, "_Barplot_byLifestage.pdf")),
       plot = p_lifestage, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 600)
```

```{r plots-by-sample-type-fam, results='asis', fig.height=6, fig.width=12}
# recode low-abundance taxa as 'Other"

# aggregate again to sum 'Other' values
```

```{r plots-by-sample-type-fam2, results='asis', fig.height=6, fig.width=12}
  ggsave(paste0(output_base, ".pdf"), plot = p, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  
  plot_list[[as.character(current_taxa)]] <- p
}
```

## Summary Statistics: Top Families Across Dataset

```{r summary-top-taxa, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# collapse to desired taxrank and relative abundance 
ps_tax <- tax_glom(ps, taxrank = taxrank)
ps_relabund <- transform_sample_counts(ps_tax, function(x) x / sum(x))
df <- psmelt(ps_relabund)

# Clean taxrank NA
df[[taxrank]] <- as.character(df[[taxrank]])
df[[taxrank]][is.na(df[[taxrank]])] <- "Unclassified"

# calculate mean relative abundance across the entire dataset
top_taxa_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(.data[[taxrank]]) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_abundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_abundance = median(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_abundance = sd(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_abundance = max(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_abundance = min(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_samples_present = sum(Abundance > 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_abundance)) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n)

# Save as CSV
write.csv(top_taxa_summary, file = file.path(output_dir, paste0("Top_", taxrank, "_Summary.csv")), row.names = FALSE)

# Display table in knitted document
top_taxa_summary %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(., 3))) %>%
  kable(caption = paste0("Top ", top_n, " Most Abundant ", taxrank, " Across Entire Dataset"),
        align = "lrrrrrr") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"))

# extra summary by Sample_Type 
top_taxa_by_sampletype <- df %>%
  filter(.data[[taxrank]] %in% top_taxa_summary[[taxrank]]) %>%
  group_by(Sample_Type, .data[[taxrank]]) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_abundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_abundance = median(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_abundance = sd(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_samples_present = sum(Abundance > 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Sample_Type, desc(mean_abundance))

write.csv(top_taxa_by_sampletype, file = file.path(output_dir, paste0("Top_", taxrank, "_By_SampleType.csv")), row.names = FALSE)

# summary by lifestage  
top_taxa_by_lifestage <- df %>%
  filter(.data[[taxrank]] %in% top_taxa_summary[[taxrank]]) %>%
  group_by(Lifestage, .data[[taxrank]]) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_abundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_abundance = median(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_abundance = sd(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_samples_present = sum(Abundance > 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Lifestage, desc(mean_abundance))

write.csv(top_taxa_by_lifestage, file = file.path(output_dir, paste0("Top_", taxrank, "_By_Lifestage.csv")), row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r summary-plot-fam}
# Filter top taxa from previously calculated top_taxa_summary (or recalc top taxa names)
top_taxa_names <- top_taxa_summary[[taxrank]]  # from summary table chunk

# Filter dataframe for only those top taxa
plot_df <- df %>% filter(.data[[taxrank]] %in% top_taxa_names)

# create colour palette based on number of taxa
n_taxa <- length(top_taxa_names)
if (n_taxa <= 8) {
  fill_scale <- scale_fill_brewer(palette = pal, name = taxrank)
} else {
  fill_colors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, pal))(n_taxa)
  fill_scale <- scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors, name = taxrank)
}

# Plot 1: Boxplot of relative abundance across entire dataset
p_summary <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = .data[[taxrank]], y = Abundance, fill = .data[[taxrank]])) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  fill_scale +
  labs(
    title = paste("Top", top_n, taxrank, "Relative Abundance Across Entire Dataset"),
    x = taxrank,
    y = "Relative Abundance"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_summary)

ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0("Summary_Top", top_n, "_", taxrank, "_Barplot.png")),
       plot = p_summary, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)


# Plot by Sample Type
```
